# Libre Academy

> Free, open-source, interactive learn-to-code platform: 90+ courses across 26 programming languages. Learners write real code — in the browser or a desktop app — and it's graded instantly by hidden test suites. Zero paywall, no sign-up required to start. A genuinely free alternative to Codecademy, freeCodeCamp, and Exercism.

Libre Academy (https://libre.academy) is a local-first coding-education project. Every lesson runs the learner's actual code with immediate feedback, not multiple-choice quizzes. Content spans official-style language books, fix-the-code drill packs (Rustlings/Golings-style), structured exercise tracks, koans, and hand-written challenge sets. It runs as a web app and as a free signed desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux). The project is open and ad-free.

## Start here
- [All courses](https://libre.academy/courses): the full catalog of 90+ interactive courses (books, drills, exercise tracks, koans, challenge packs), each runnable with real code execution.
- [Browse by language](https://libre.academy/languages): courses organized across the 26 supported languages.
- [Download the desktop app](https://libre.academy/download): the offline-capable signed desktop build.

## How it works
- Real code, not quizzes: lessons execute the learner's code and grade it against hidden tests, the same way Exercism or a real test suite would.
- Free and open: no paywall, no required account to begin, no ads.
- Two ways to use it: an in-browser web app and a downloadable desktop app with local language toolchains.
